libs.note: BH-7256. The operator filer of the CI image rollout children (docs/CI-IMAGES.md "Rollout (slice 4)"). It calls lib_env_apply ci-image-rollout once at start, so a lib.ci-image-rollout.<env lowercased> settings row sets the knob; no row leaves the env value, then the code fallback.

knobs.note: curl --max-time for each app-board call (boards list, tickets list, ticket create). Read as ${CI_ROLLOUT_CURL_MAX_TIME:-25}; a non-integer falls back to 25 and the value is clamped to 5..120. Was a literal 25, the value bin/file-health-ticket.sh uses for the same app-board API.

per_page of the GitHub search/issues dedup read before each create. Read as ${CI_ROLLOUT_SEARCH_PER_PAGE:-100}; a non-integer falls back to 100 and the value is clamped to 1..100 (GitHub's search cap). Was a literal 100.
